What is the difference between mutable and immutable objects?

Supplied answer
Mutable objects can be changed after creation: list, dict, set, bytearray. Immutable objects cannot be
changed: int, float, str, tuple, bool, frozenset. With an immutable object any "change" actually creates a
new object, which is why s = s + "a" gives a new string.
